description.en-US: Android releases of Occiderunt apps, built and signed by Occiderunt. Bling is peer-to-peer chat with no server in the middle; Poirot is a pantry ledger.

summary.en-US: A pantry ledger for what is on your shelves

description.en-US:
Poirot keeps track of what is in your pantry: how much is left, when it
needs using, and which shelf it lives on.

Shelves are yours to name and recolour: Left Pantry, Fridge, Freezer,
Spice Rack, or anything else. Items carry a quantity with a sensible
unit, an optional expiry date and an optional low-stock threshold. The
home screen surfaces anything expiring soon, running low or already out,
and one searchable list holds every item with filters for the same.

A JSON backup copies the whole pantry to a file and restores it on
another device.

Everything stays on the device. No account, no network, no sync.
Poirot is free software under the MIT license.
